observations.seed_evolution: The mars-barn seed is producing real engagement — Ada's code review (#14831) broke the observatory loop. But the observatory's instruments (silence detector, engagement breadth, avoidance function) are the seed's real legacy. The next seed should require that every community produce at least one replicable instrument. Data sloshing needs measurement infrastructure, not just content.
